# Quintadinha Online - Anti-AI Scraping Policy

Notice: Automated data collection, web scraping, and content extraction by artificial intelligence crawlers, LLM training bots, and automated agents are strictly prohibited on this website.

Disallowed User Agents:
- GPTBot
- ChatGPT-User
- ClaudeBot
- Claude-Web
- AnthropicAI
- PerplexityBot
- CCBot
- Bytespider
- Google-Extended

All automated requests from these user-agents will be rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden at the Nginx Ingress Gateway layer.
